study: Garet et al. 2011, Middle School Math PD Impact Study (NCEE 2011-4024)
eval_evidence: IES/NCEE-commissioned impact study; prime contractor AIR with MDRC. Evaluators distinct from the PD providers (America's Choice, Pearson Achievement Solutions).
developer_evidence: PD designed and delivered by external commercial providers America's Choice and Pearson Achievement Solutions (their own facilitators/coaches delivered the institutes, seminars, and coaching).
cascade_evidence: Provider facilitators delivered institutes/seminars and the same seminar facilitators (provider coaches) delivered the coaching visits to teachers directly; no train-the-trainer hop.
counterfactual_evidence: Control was the district's 'business as usual' math PD; report explicitly contrasts treatment vs business-as-usual control hours (Table 2-7).
coaching_evidence: In-school coaching tied to each of ~5 seminar days/year (two-day coaching visits, ~4-5 hrs/teacher), i.e. periodic in-class support across the year rather than monthly+ recurring cycles.
student_dose_evidence: Intervention targets teachers' own grade-7 math instruction (rational numbers); no tutoring, pull-out, or added student-facing dose.
maturity_evidence: Two-year PD program; extracted outcomes are the end-of-second-year (two-year-district) wave, i.e. after a prior year of implementation.
